facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: corrective action - key safeguard at PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 25 March 2007 a corrective action on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
